title: Remove the retained Windows B job directory s9-bba11-native once its junction is unlinked and a permitted session can delete it
outcome: Remove the retained Windows B job directory s9-bba11-native once its junction is unlinked and a permitted session can delete it
acceptance: On Windows B, the Engram runner clone's target/jobs/s9-bba11-native (about 1.37 GB) and worktree .worktrees/bba11-native-s9 are gone, removed after an absolute-path check inside the clone and after its Content.IE5 junction was unlinked non-recursively, with the removal recorded here
